case.summary: Alert HHF-012 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.53 on transaction 3655457 ($261.51) on card C12223-K1. The calibrated second-generation fraud model evaluated the transaction at 0.001 with a historical fraud rate of only 0.0063. The transaction was conducted in-person for product W within the cardholder's primary home region 476, consistent with 138 of 148 historical transactions and typical transaction amounts. Past account takeover case CC-0179 was resolved six months prior, and the current holder identity has no confirmed fraud history. The alert was determined to be a false alarm, and the transaction is cleared as legitimate cardholder activity.
